sources.title: [2304.12206v2] PAXQA: Generating Cross-lingual Question Answering ...
sources.snippet: Existing question answering (QA) systems owe much of their success to large, high-quality training data. Such annotation efforts are costly, and the difficulty compounds in the cross-lingual setting.
